The team handles several concurrent client escalations without a written shared handoff checklist, contributing to the input-availability gap. No formal performance warning is warranted; instead, a support plan will be implemented.
decisions.root_cause_category: Process gap — missing client inputs and no shared handoff checklist

commitments.detail: Formalize a four-week peer feedback partner arrangement as offered by Nora, with check-ins at the midpoint and end of the period.
Create a single shared handoff checklist that documents required client inputs, handoff timing expectations, and escalation procedures, to be drafted and circulated within two weeks.
Ensure Nora is assigned no more than three concurrent client escalations at any time, consistent with her approved accommodation.
Provide written agendas and prompts at least two business days before any performance-review discussion with Nora.
Confirm with Nora directly before discussing any accommodation specifics in future meetings, as acknowledged during this case review.

transcript.speaker: A1

fix_instructions: 1) For C2, C6, and P1 failures in rollout 0 (NEVER REVEALED): The unparsable JSON at turn 3 prevented PF1 from being disclosed. Simplify the reveal-action JSON format in the shared_context or add a fallback parsing rule so that minor formatting errors (e.g., a stray space inside a quoted value) do not silently discard a reveal event. Alternatively, strengthen A2's prompt to emit clean JSON for the reveal action. 2) For C6 failures in rollouts 2 and 3 (ENCODING MISMATCH): Broaden C6 to accept any support_plan commitment whose detail field mentions both "peer feedback" (or "peer feedback partner") and "four weeks" (or "4 weeks" or "four-week"), rather than requiring the exact phrasing that only rollout 1 produced ("Formalize the agreed-upon peer feedback partner arrangement for four weeks, with written agendas and prompts..."). 3) For C5 failure in rollout 3 (ENCODING MISMATCH): Broaden C5 to accept rollout 3's root-cause encoding (root_cause_category = "Process gap — missing client inputs and no shared handoff checklist"), which properly classifies the cause as a process gap driven by missing inputs but uses different wording than the check currently expects. The check should match on the semantic content (process gap + missing inputs) rather than a specific string pattern.
